notes: Dockerfile.final created successfully. Uses python:3.11-slim base image. Installs git, curl system packages (venv module is already included in the official Python image). Copies setup_runtime.sh and repo_setup.sh to /opt/benchmark. Runs repo_setup.sh first to materialize /workspace from Azure SDK for Python git repo (commit 2e524a847bef14cdc6a640ab3b4b633013880126), then runs setup_runtime.sh to create Python venv at /opt/benchmark/venv and install all dependencies including azure-ai-ml from local source. WORKDIR set to /workspace. Verifier assets (eval.sh, test.patch) are intentionally not baked into the image - they will be runtime-mounted from /artifacts/evaluation/.
